_doc: 정본: anchors 는 사람이 고친다(원문 확인한 날짜·출처만). stats·tempo·data 는 scripts/risk_calendar.py 가 매일 다시 쓴다.

anchors.name: 자유의방패(한미연합 · 봄)

2006.quote: Reception, Staging, Onward-Movement and Integration (RSOI) and Foal Eagle (FE) 2006 took place March 25-31 in the Republic of Korea (ROK)
2006.note: RSOI·FE 통합 기간(지휘소 단독 날짜 미기재) · GlobalSecurity 미러(미 해군 NNS 원문)

2007.quote: the annually scheduled combined and joint Exercise Reception, Staging, Onward movement, & Integration and Foal Eagle 2007 (RSOI/FOAL EAGLE 07), from March 25 to 31.
2007.note: RSOI·FE 통합 기간(지휘소 단독 날짜 미기재) · GlobalSecurity 미러(미 해군 NNS 원문)

2008.quote: South Korea and the United States began their annual large-scale military exercise Sunday. ... Joint drills will be conducted through March 7 in multiple locations throughout South Korea
2008.note: 키리졸브 첫해 · 독수리 야외기동이 3.7 뒤까지 갔는지 미확인

2009.quote: Key Resolve/Foal Eagle 2009 began Monday and will continue through March 20 across the Republic of Korea.
2009.note: KR/FE 3.9~20 · 독수리 4.30 설(위키)은 원문 미확인이라 미반영

2010.quote: Eighth (Field) Army Soldiers are participating from March 8 - 18 in Key Resolve/Foal Eagle 2010, the first of two annual peninsula-wide exercises in South Korea.
2010.note: 주의: 종료일 불확실 — KR/FE 3.8~18 은 원문 확인, 독수리 야외기동이 3.18 뒤(4월)까지 이어졌을 수 있음(원문 403 미확인)

2011.quote: the annual exercises, code-named Key Resolve and Foal Eagle, will begin February 28 and run through April. ... The Key Resolve drill ... will last through March 10. The Foal Eagle exercise ... will continue until April 30.

2012.quote: South Korea and the U.S. kicked off their joint Key Resolve military exercise on Monday ... The Key Resolve, which will go on until March 9 ... the Foal Eagle, will take place from March 1 to April 30.

2013.quote: About 13,500 U.S. troops will participate in the Foal Eagle exercise March 1-April 30 or the Key Resolve exercise March 11-21.
2013.note: 독수리 3.1~4.30 + 키리졸브 3.11~21(사전 발표, 사후 보도로 확인)

2014.quote: The Key Resolve command post exercise will take place Feb. 24-March 6, and the Foal Eagle field training exercise will run Feb. 24-April 18, according to the U.S. military.

2015.quote: The computerized command post exercise, called Key Resolve, will be held from March 2-13 ... the allies are scheduled to hold the field training exercise Foal Eagle ... from March 2 to April 24.

2016.quote: SEOUL, March 7 -- South Korea and the United States on Monday kicked off ... The Key Resolve command post exercise ... through March 18, with the Foal Eagle field training exercise lasting until April 30.

2017.quote: down from last year's eight-week program, which kicked off on March 1.

2018.quote: got under way Sunday as scheduled ... the four-week Foal Eagle training ... The allies will also kick off a two-week Key Resolve command-post war game April 23
2018.note: 4.1 시작은 원문 확인 · 5.3 은 키리졸브 종료(다른 출처)

2019.quote: Dong Maeng will be held from March 4 to 12, except for the weekend, on a much smaller scale than the previous two exercises,

2021.quote: South Korea and the United States on Monday kicked off a springtime combined military exercise ... The computer-simulated Combined Command Post Training (CCPT), set to continue until March 18

2022.quote: kicked off major springtime military exercise on Monday ... will run for nine days from Monday

2023.quote: In a press release Friday, militaries of both countries said Freedom Shield will last from March 13 to 23.

2024.quote: The exercise will run from Mar. 4-14 and is focused on countering North Korea's growing nuclear threat.

2025.quote: The allies began the Freedom Shield exercise, which runs through March 20,

2026.quote: will hold large-scale springtime military drills on countering North Korean threats from March 9 to 19

anchors.note: 창 기준: 2006~2018 = 키리졸브(지휘소)+독수리(야외기동) 연합 전체 기간(2016·2018 기존 항목과 같은 기준), 2019~ = 독수리 폐지 뒤 지휘소 연습(동맹·연합지휘소훈련·자유의방패) 기간. 2006~2015 는 길게는 2달 창이라 그해 「평소라면」 확률이 높게 잡힌다. 2017 은 시작일만 확인(종료 미확인 → 하루 창).

anchors.name: 을지자유의방패(한미연합 · 여름)

2006.quote: Exercise Ulchi Focus Lens '06 ran from Aug. 21 through Sept. 1 across the Korean peninsula.
2006.note: 을지포커스렌즈 · GlobalSecurity 정리 페이지(1차 원문 아님)

2007.quote: This year's Ulchi Focus Lens, August 20-31. was the 31st of its kind.
2007.note: 을지포커스렌즈 · GlobalSecurity 정리 페이지(1차 원문 아님)

2008.quote: Combined Forces Command officials announced late Thursday that the upcoming Ulchi Freedom Guardian exercise will take place Aug. 18-22.
2008.note: 주의: 사전 발표값만(종료 사후 확인 없음) · 을지프리덤가디언 첫해

2009.quote: Ulchi Freedom Guardian, the world's largest annual computerized command and control exercise, is being conducted Aug. 17 - 28 by Republic of Korea and United States military forces.

2010.quote: The militaries of South Korea and the United States will start their annual Ulchi Freedom Guardian (UFG) exercise Aug. 16 ... The computerized simulation war games, which will run through Aug. 26

2011.quote: The U.S. Army's top operational headquarters in South Korea will train with its Republic of Korea counterparts ... during Exercise Ulchi Freedom Guardian, Aug. 16-26.

2012.quote: The annual Ulchi Freedom Guardian exercise took place from Aug 20-31, 2012.
2012.note: GlobalSecurity 정리 페이지(1차 원문 아님) · 중앙일보 보도와 일치

2013.quote: The Republic of Korea U.S. Combined Forces Command conducted the annual Ulchi Freedom Guardian exercise Aug. 19 through Aug. 30.

2014.quote: The biggest U.S.-South Korea war games ended Thursday as they began, with little fanfare ... It was scheduled to end Friday.

2015.quote: The Republic of Korea United States Combined Forces Command conducted the annual exercise Ulchi Freedom Guardian 2015 Aug. 17 to Aug. 28.
2015.note: GlobalSecurity 정리 페이지(1차 원문 아님) · 성조지 보도와 일치

2016.quote: From August 22 till September 2, one of three major annual U.S.-ROK maneuvers, "Ulchi Freedom Guardian", were conducted.

2017.quote: will hold the annual Ulchi Freedom Guardian exercise Aug. 21-31

2019.quote: SEOUL - South Korea and the United States began a joint military drill Monday despite warnings from North Korea
2019.note: 8.5 = 사전 위기관리 참모훈련 시작 · 본훈련 8.11경 · 종료 8.20(신화)

2020.quote: South Korea and the United States on Tuesday kicked off their annual summertime combined exercise ... which will run until Aug. 28,

2021.quote: The computer-simulated Combined Command Post Training (CCPT) is expected to be held from Aug. 16-26

2022.quote: The US and South Korea on Monday kicked off annual joint military exercises, summertime drills known as Ulchi Freedom Shield. ... scheduled to run through September 1.

2023.quote: is set to take place from Aug. 21-31

2024.quote: is scheduled to take place from Aug. 19 to 29

2025.quote: began their annual large-scale military exercise Monday ... will be carried out for 11 days and concludes on Aug. 28.

2026.quote: The exercise began Monday and had originally been scheduled to run through Aug. 27. | The exercise will conclude on Aug. 21, six days earlier than scheduled.

anchors.note: 창 기준: 전 기간 지휘소 연습(을지포커스렌즈 → 을지프리덤가디언 → 을지자유의방패) 기간 — 2006~2015 와 2016~ 같은 기준.

anchors.name: 미국 선거일(대선·중간)
anchors.note: 2006~2014 는 법정일 계산(2 U.S.C. §7: 11월 첫 월요일 다음 화요일).

next.label: 호국훈련(한국군)
next.note: 종료일 보도 엇갈림 — 10.23(연합뉴스) / 10.30(헤럴드). 표시는 늦은 쪽까지

tempo.basis: CSIS 미사일·핵 도발 날짜, 평소 = 2016~2025 평균

_verify: 훈련 연도별 check = 원문 인용·판정(2016~ 2026-10-18 검증 · 2006~2015 2026-10-18 조사 추가). confirmed 36 · start_only 4(note 참고). USFK.mil 은 403 이라 보도·Wayback 으로 대체. GlobalSecurity 정리 페이지는 1차 원문 아님(note 표기)
_exercises: 외국 훈련은 공식 발표 원문을 연 것만(2026-10-18 조사). 일본 통합막료감부·중국 해사국 목록 페이지는 403 — 새 공고는 수동 확인. 대만 해군 정례 해상훈련(가오슝 남서)은 한반도 판단과 무관해 제외

season.basis: 발사한 날(CSIS ∪ CNS) 2006~2025 · 평소 = 그해 발사한 날 수 × 달 길이/1년

relaunch.basis: 발사한 날 228일(2006~2025) 각각의 다음 발사까지 간격

signal_check.basis: 신호를 처음 본 날부터 14일 안 CSIS 미사일·핵 발사 여부 · 기간이 다 지난 신호만
